name: Three Heads (Are Better Than One)
body:
You have the qualities of a goat, a dragon, a lion, a snake, and person- that gives you a lot of insight into a lot of minds.

Prerequisite(s): Dai’Chi.

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 insight bonus on all Charisma based skill checks against goats and goat-like creatures, dragons and dragon-like creatures, lions and lion-like creatures, snakes and snake-like creatures, and chimeras and chimera-like creatures.
